summary: Customer wants in-line monitoring of sucrose concentration in a clear, colourless aqueous solution flowing through a 50 mm stainless steel pipe at 20 to 30 °C and normal pressure, with 5 to 15 % w/w range, ±0.3 % w/w quality limit, lab refractometer reference, analyser 10 m away in a dry safe room, hot caustic CIP once a day, and one reading per minute. They ask for a method and probe for a first trial.
